findings.title: delay-analysis awards EOT and contractor damages with no critical-path gate, no evidence, and caller-chosen DelayType
findings.description: DelayAnalyzer.add_delay_event accepts attacker-chosen DelayType (including EXCUSABLE_COMPENSABLE) with documented=True by default and empty supporting_docs. calculate_delay_damages / generate_analysis_report then sum calendar-day spans (or TIA impact) for every EXCUSABLE event into recommended_time_extension and contractor_delay_damages = days * daily_cost — with no critical-path filter and no documentation check. perform_time_impact_analysis separately trusts schedule activity dict is_critical rather than computing CPM, and still awards delay_duration-5 days when is_critical is false (hardcoded float).
findings.impact: Fabricated owner-caused delays produce multi-month EOT recommendations and multi-million dollar delay-damage figures that flow into claims reports without schedule proof or evidence attachments.
attack_path: Call add_delay_event(..., DelayType.EXCUSABLE_COMPENSABLE, start/end spanning 91 days, affected_activities=['NONEXISTENT'], supporting_docs=[]). documented defaults True.
Skip TIA / skip baseline entirely — or, for TIA path, add_schedule_version with activities={id: {is_critical: True}}.
calculate_delay_damages() / generate_analysis_report() return recommended_time_extension=91 and contractor_delay_damages=$3,640,000 for use in claim documentation.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Distinct from toolkit schedule-delay-analyzer: that skill's calculate_time_extension_claim requires on_critical_path=True. Insights calculate_delay_damages has no critical-path gate, defaults documented=True with empty docs, falls back to raw calendar span without TIA, and emits contractor_delay_damages from daily_cost. Not the already-reported schedule-compression false recovery or Insights CPA zero-duration. Prior hunt listed DelayType only as a discarded near-miss; this is the complete EOT+money chain with validated PoC.
key_snippets: if act.get('is_critical', False): critical_impact = True  # TIA trusts caller
impact_days = max(0, delay_duration - 5)  # non-critical still gets impact
